conservative.read: This conservative approach aims for capital preservation with lower volatility. Expect modest potential gains, with a focus on reducing drawdown risk. A larger cash position will buffer against market swings.

plan: Trim QQQI to 20% to manage concentration.

This plan balances growth with risk reduction.

balanced.read: This balanced plan seeks risk-first growth by trimming concentration and leverage while adding a promising new name. Expect moderate potential returns with controlled risk. A cash buffer will help manage volatility.

plan: Trim QQQI to 20% to manage concentration.
Increase leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, PLTU) to 6% each.
Add ON and TSLA, both strong scanner setups, at 6% each.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan aims for stretched growth by increasing leverage and concentrating in strong setups, including leveraged ETFs. Expect higher potential returns but also significantly larger drawdowns and amplified volatility due to leverage and ETF decay. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Increase QQQI to 30% for income generation.

income.read: This income-focused plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions over growth. By selling high-beta and leveraged assets, it aims for lower volatility and more predictable income. Note that NAV can still decline in market downturns, and distributions are not guaranteed.
